Embedded Wallets

Your product. Their keys. Zero wallet infrastructure to build.

Payward Embedded Wallets puts non-custodial wallets inside your product, under your brand. TEE-based signing, a plug-in integration layer, and a battle-tested SDK, all proven across more than 60 million wallets. Your users get true self-custody. You get to market in weeks.
Get in touch with sales
60M+
Wallets powered
$10B+
Stablecoin volume
Ship wallets in weeks, not quarters
Skip the year of key-management engineering. The Payward Embedded Wallets SDK handles generation, signing, and recovery out of the box, so your team builds the product, not the plumbing.
Give users self-custody, without becoming a custodian
Your users hold their own keys, secured by TEE-based signing. You deliver full onchain experiences with no custody burden on your books.
Turn wallets into revenue
Every wallet holds assets, and held assets can earn. Layer onchain earning and stablecoin payments onto your wallets to open new revenue streams and give users a reason to keep their funds with you.
Complete your stack with one integration
Wallets sit alongside crypto trading, custody, on/off-ramps, tokenized equities, staking, and card issuance. One API. One relationship. Nothing left to stitch together.

Key capabilities

TEE-based signing
Keys are generated and used inside trusted execution environments. Non-custodial by design: your users control their assets, always.
Plug-in integration
Drop wallet creation and signing flows straight into your product. Your brand, your UX, live fast.
Proven at scale
The infrastructure behind 60 million-plus wallets and over $10 billion in stablecoin volume. Not a bet. A track record.
Onchain by default
Wallets plug directly into onchain earning, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets across supported networks.
One platform, full stack
Combine wallets with Payward Services trading, custody, ramps, and yield. A single integrated stack where others need five vendors.

Frequently asked questions

With Payward Embedded Wallets, your users hold their own keys, which are generated and used inside trusted execution environments, so you carry no custody burden on your books. If you'd rather we hold assets for your users, Payward Services Custody provides segregated custody for every asset we support. See coverage.

Embedded Wallets connect to onchain features across supported networks. Across Payward Services, stablecoins such as USDC and USDT are supported on several networks, alongside major cryptocurrencies and tokenized equities (xStocks). Coverage varies by product and is subject to regulatory requirements in each jurisdiction, so confirm your countries and assets with the Payward team. Details are in the coverage overview.

Yes, where the asset and the user's country are eligible. Wallet balances can earn through our staking and yield products. See Staking & Yield.

Yes. You get a sandbox from day one. It's fully separate from production and uses test balances instead of real funds, so your team can build and run end-to-end flows before launch. Ask us how to test wallet-specific flows. When you're ready, we enable production access. See Environments.
